$comment: Machine-readable conformance contract, derived from .agent/references/spec/*.dc.html (the authoritative AEGIS reference pages). Consumed by .agent/scripts/verify-conformance.mjs, which is a HARD GATE. Component names map to kebab source files; note toggle -> switch.

universal.$comment: Rules every component in src/components/ui must satisfy — the shared AEGIS design language.

forbidden.message: Hard-coded box-shadow literal. Use `shadow-elevated` (the --shadow token) for elevation.
shadcn default focus ring. AEGIS focus is a 3px accent-soft ring (`ring-accent-soft`) + accent border.
Hard-coded hex color. Use an AEGIS token/utility (colors are token-only).
Hard-coded rgba color. Use a token/utility.

button.notes: Default variant is `secondary`. Primary carries the rotating beam (conic-gradient) + gradient fill + underglow. Loading holds width, shows a spinner (animate-spin), sets aria-busy. Sizes 32/38/46px. Focus = 3px accent-soft ring.

checkbox.notes: Box 16/20/24px (default md=20). Mark pops in with check-pop. Supports label + description slots. Indeterminate bar. Focus = accent-soft ring; resting border = border-strong.

switch.notes: Track 36x20 / 44x26 (default md) / 52x30. Thumb inset 3px, pure-white thumb. Optional showIcons glyphs (check on / bar off). label + description slots. Off-track uses the --track token.

badge.notes: Two axes: tone (10, incl. severity ramp low/medium/high/critical + info) x variant style (soft default/solid/outline). Optional dot (pulse-dot), leading icon, numeric count with max -> 99+. Per-size radius 6/7/8px.

avatar.notes: Diameter xs24/sm32/md40/lg64/xl88. Fallback chain image->initials->icon. Name-seeded initials color (hash -> 8-pair palette). Presence dot (online pings). ring (current-user). AvatarGroup stack + +N overflow (max 4). square radius 28%.

chip.notes: Not yet built. Removable token; chip-pop entrance. Follow reference when built.

input.notes: Not yet built. Leading/trailing adornments; focus = accent-soft ring + accent border; resting border-strong. Sizes 32/40/48px.

select.notes: Not yet built. Menu enters with menu-in; chevron rotates 180deg; selected row tint + check.

radio.notes: Not yet built. Ring 16/20/24px; inner dot pops in (dot-pop); focus = accent-soft ring.
